themes.description: Covers feedback related to the overall ease of use, intuitiveness, and satisfaction with the application's design and interaction.
Covers feedback related to the availability, functionality, and enhancement of specific trading tools and features within the application.
This theme covers feedback regarding the platform's effectiveness or suitability for specific trading instruments, strategies, or user needs.
This theme addresses feedback related to security protocols, authentication steps (like TPIN/OTP), and their impact on the efficiency or user experience of transactions.
Covers problems related to account balances, position management, incorrect financial calculations, and unauthorized actions on an account.
This theme covers feedback related to the design, convenience, and overall user experience of specific application features, including changes in functionality.
This theme covers feedback related to the availability, depth, or specific limitations of data displayed in charts and for analysis.
This theme covers suggestions for new features, modifications to existing functionalities, or feedback on product offerings and plans.
Covers feedback related to specific functionalities, tools, or interfaces within the application, including positive and negative comments about their design or utility.
Feedback concerning the ease of use, intuitiveness, and overall user experience of the application's interface and features.
Concerns about specific product features, their design, or the financial risks associated with using them, especially for new users.
General feedback, positive or negative, regarding recent application updates, new features, or changes in user experience introduced by an update.
This theme covers issues related to account opening, closing, unauthorized activity, and general account administration.
This theme covers questions and feedback related to the user interface, navigation, settings, and general ease of use of the application.
Reviews related to overall satisfaction, positive feedback, or general user experience with the application.
This theme covers issues related to referral programs, including unreceived rewards, lack of transparency, or problems with the referral system.
Issues related to order placement, execution, auto-squaring logic, and unexpected trade outcomes.
This theme covers requests or complaints related to the availability of specific investment products, fund types, or options for managing investments like dividend reinvestment.
Requests for new features, enhancements to existing functionalities, or improvements to the user interface and navigation.
